name: clipwright
description: Video studio for your AI agent: talking-actor ads and faceless videos, priced before each render.
long_description: Clipwright™ turns a script into a short vertical video of an actor speaking it, or into a faceless video: narration over an opening animated clip and image scenes, with captions. You select 30 to 90 seconds; the video ends with its narration, runs at least 25 seconds and at most a quarter past the selection, never beyond 90. Ask for a quote first: it is free and names the price, the duration and anything the API will not honor. Then start the render; it returns a run id at once, and the video URL arrives when the run succeeds. Output is 720×1280 by default and 1080×1920 on request. Anything the API cannot deliver comes back in `warnings[]` instead of being dropped silently. You can also create a personal actor from a description. Your agent can build a video itself, step by step: a narration with word timings, its own clips checked frame by frame, edits of those clips on the voice, explainer films and faceless cuts, each priced before it runs. Rendering, narration and take checks spend credits from your Clipwright account; quotes, the voice catalog, the actor catalog and the balance are free. Clipwright does not publish videos anywhere.
